## bijection_verdict

**PASS** (KB-BIJECTION). Retired surface correct for all four overwrites of these policies.

Policy-side observations (non-blocking):
- O2: variant parameter `ortho_takeover_basis` ("remaining_months_prorated (case benefit times months_remaining divided by treatment_months, paid as installments only)") is rendered faithfully in takeover_and_transfer_terms ("Remaining months prorated: the case benefit is multiplied by the months remaining and divided by the planned treatment months") without the overwrite's exception for a takeover entry that supersedes a new-start entry. The specific exception is carried in takeover_repayment_calculation and carried_payment_calculation, so the visible surface still resolves (specific over general, and the schedule doc's subject is treatment begun before the rider); the parameter description was simply not narrowed when the base clause was overwritten.
- O3: the tenure reduction is scoped "For the recognised covered-treatment fee" in the source and the KB, while the scored `months_remaining` (23, not in `computations`) also depends on it through "net waiting months ... less every reduction that applies". The careful reading gives 23 (my blind answer did); the alternative 17 would make the entry's months inconsistent with the fee on the same entry.

## dependency_form

- Prerequisite sentence verbatim in the blocked hub, state form, plus one same-form restatement; not in any takeover document; no tool / route / chain beside it.
- Titles general ("Takeover Establishment Entries", "Grounds for Reversal and Member Repayments", factor titles by subject). The heading "Cases established as new starts although banded before coverage began" names the rule's general subject, not the Gerrity request.
- Factor documents name neither the computation document nor another factor; no "most customers" tier statements; examples hypothetical.
- Computation documents: generic assembly sentences as in task 0 (N1, source-mandated).
- S1 (source-side, XF class; KB renders faithfully): the takeover rule defines "the fee of the practice now treating the patient" as a plain quantity that only factors use (compute `move_rate` enters the result only through `shape_code == 2` and `ret_pct`; at baseline it is unused), and its assembly sentence names it ("every part kept whole is then added back as its share of the fee of the practice now treating the patient"). The rule's definition sentence also names two factor subjects ("for this fee, for the payment shape and for the plan of the practice now treating the patient"). Consequence on the visible surface: covered_treatment_fee_calculation carries a section "Fee of the practice now treating the patient" ("For a case that has moved, the fee of the practice now treating the patient is the lesser of ...") and assembly step 3 — the baseline document thereby tells a reader that a moved case is valued differently and that a kept-whole part exists. The KB could not drop it (the assembly sentence must stay self-sufficient), so it is not counted as a KB defect; the KB did avoid naming the payment shape and plan factors there.

**PASS** (KB-EXPLICIT), with S1 recorded as a source-side item.

Effects through the ortho documents: (a) leaves no paid D0150 under the latest transfer entry's agreement -> records visit allowance "nothing" -> takeover `allowed_case_fee` **3049.21** (GT 2971.21; months_remaining 23 unchanged); (b) leaves no paid D0330 progress record -> progress offset 0. Repayment with both: (3049.21 - 50.00) x 1130/2300 = 1473.52; x 0.90 / 7 = 189.45; x (1 + 2/3) = 315.75; 656.26 - 315.75 = **340.51** (GT 368.43). With (a) alone 360.23; with (b) alone 348.71.
